newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong gold ends shade down following palladium.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong gold ends shade down following palladium.

text.p: Hong Kong gold ended a shade lower on Monday compared to New York's Friday close following morning sales on the back of a drop in palladium and platinum prices, dealers said.
"The local market was very quiet in cautious trade today," a senior dealer at a local investment house said. "The price of gold stayed within a 40 cent range all day."
Bullion ended at US$344.00/50 an ounce against New York's US$344.40/90 close on Friday.
"The gold price kept moving, we couldn't guess which direction it would head for next," a dealer added. "Support was seen at US$340, while resistance was pitched at about US$348."
Local gold ended HK$5 lower at HK$3,181 a tael.
The carry over charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society dropped to -5.00 from its Saturday fix at -4.50.
